Dear Adshot team,

I'm writing to apply for the Influencer Marketing Account Manager role. Your work with brands like Proximus, the Flemish government, and JBL, and your early adoption of Twitch and TikTok creators, stands out. I'd love to bring my digital marketing and client-facing experience to your team.

At Episto, I manage SEO and content for client websites, handling multiple projects and keeping clients updated. At Knowledge Experts, I supported digital workplace projects for major brands like ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, which taught me to turn client goals into clear targets. I also run my own freelance practice, building and optimizing websites for clients—an entrepreneurial approach that fits Adshot's spirit.

I understand the influencer landscape through my work in content and social media, and I'm fluent in English with Dutch writing skills (B1). I'm organized, solve problems creatively, and enjoy collaborating with campaign managers to keep projects on track.

I'd welcome the chance to discuss how I can contribute to Adshot's campaigns.

Best regards,

cover_letter:
Dear Adshot team,

I'm excited to apply for the Influencer Marketing Account Manager position at Adshot. Your agency's reputation for innovative campaigns with top brands like Proximus, the Flemish government, and JBL, and your pioneering work with Twitch and TikTok creators, resonates with me. I'm eager to bring my digital marketing and client management experience to your team.

In my current role as a Junior Digital Marketer at Episto, I manage SEO and content for multiple client websites, coordinating tasks and ensuring client satisfaction. This experience has honed my ability to handle several projects simultaneously and communicate effectively with clients. Previously, at Knowledge Experts, I supported digital workplace projects for major brands such as ŞOK Market and Aras Kargo, where I learned to translate client objectives into actionable plans and deliver results. These roles have given me a strong foundation in understanding client needs and maintaining strong relationships.

As a freelancer, I've built and optimized websites for various clients, from a youth chess champion to e-commerce stores. This entrepreneurial experience has taught me to be proactive, solve problems creatively, and manage my own schedule—qualities that align with Adshot's emphasis on entrepreneurial spirit and independent work. I also have a solid grasp of the influencer landscape through my content and social media work, and I stay curious about emerging trends.

I'm fluent in English and have Dutch writing skills (B1), with a willingness to improve. I'm organized, adaptable, and enjoy collaborating with campaign managers to keep campaigns running smoothly. I listen carefully but also stand firm when needed, and I'm not afraid to take initiative.

I would welcome the opportunity to discuss how my skills and enthusiasm can contribute to Adshot's success. Thank you for considering my application.

Sincerely,
Baver Ok
